name: Ladja
source:
The second sage, as well as the founder of the Liberty-Redable project. Known in the human world by the nickname “Blood Witch” due to her cruelty and madness. To achieve her goal, she is ready to stab her allies in the back. For a long time, she traveled the world.
She wanted to understand human values and what people want.
But when she realized that she could not become a new God in the human world, she decided to become a God in a new world (the World of Mtsyri). In addition, Ladja became disillusioned with people during her travels around the world.
